sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Elegant Red Rose Gold Stem Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of timeless romance to your look with this dainty red rose necklace. Featuring a vibrant crimson bud on a minimalist gold-toned stem, this anti-tarnish piece offers a sophisticated, feminine aesthetic. It's the perfect lightweight accessory for everyday elegance or a meaningful gift for someone special
